items.quote: And God said moreover unto Moses
Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel
items.claim: God commanded Moses to speak to the children of Israel

items.quote: the LORD God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath sent me unto you
items.claim: God, identified as God of the patriarchs, sent himself to the children of Israel

items.quote: this is my name for ever, and this is my memorial unto all generations
items.claim: God declares his name and memorial will be eternal and remembered through all generations
